channel.title: Daily Social Trends
channel.description: Daily raw social trends across Instagram, TikTok and Pinterest, whittled from 100+ candidates to 25 by virality, growth rate and sentiment. Client tags are filters for the reader, not a filter on the feed.

item.title: PeriTune & Audiostock — Halloween cute horror song sound
item.description: Fastest-climbing Halloween sound of the day, playful spooky use. TokConnect's Oct 28 table flagged it cleared for business use; that clearance was not independently re-verified here. Engagement: 5M videos, +100,000/day (verified). Score: virality 5/5 + growth 5/5 + sentiment 5/5 = 15/15. Sound: Halloween ・ cute horror song.
